title: Durable Execution Integrations
summary: This module provides integrations for making Pydantic AI agents durable using platforms like DBOS, Prefect, and Temporal. It wraps agents, models, and toolsets to offload operations to durable workflows or tasks, ensuring fault tolerance and state persistence.

nodes.label: DBOS Agent Wrapper
nodes.title: DBOS Agent Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps an existing Pydantic AI agent to enable durable execution using DBOS workflows. It offloads model requests and tool calls to DBOS steps, ensuring fault tolerance and state persistence.

nodes.label: DBOS MCP Toolset Base
nodes.title: DBOS MCP Toolset Base
nodes.description: Abstract base class for DBOS-wrapped MCP toolsets, integrating 'get_tools', 'get_instructions', and 'call_tool' methods as DBOS steps for durable execution.

nodes.label: Prefect Agent Wrapper
nodes.title: Prefect Agent Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps an existing Pydantic AI agent to enable durable execution using Prefect flows and tasks. It offloads model requests and tool calls to Prefect tasks.

nodes.label: Prefect Agent Cache Policy
nodes.title: Prefect Agent Cache Policy
nodes.description: A Prefect cache policy that computes cache keys for 'PrefectAgent' inputs, filtering out non-deterministic fields like timestamps and run IDs for consistent caching.

nodes.label: Prefect Toolset Wrapper
nodes.title: Prefect Toolset Wrapper
nodes.description: Function to wrap Pydantic AI toolsets (like 'FunctionToolset' and 'MCPServer') with Prefect tasks, enabling durable execution of tool operations within Prefect flows.

nodes.label: Temporal Pydantic AI Plugin
nodes.title: Temporal Pydantic AI Plugin
nodes.description: A Temporal plugin that configures the Temporal worker to recognize and execute workflows and activities defined by 'TemporalAgent' instances.

nodes.label: Temporal Agent Plugin
nodes.title: Temporal Agent Plugin
nodes.description: A specialized Temporal worker plugin for a single 'TemporalAgent' instance, registering its specific activities for execution within the Temporal workflow.

nodes.label: Temporal Agent Wrapper
nodes.title: Temporal Agent Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps an existing Pydantic AI agent to enable durable execution using Temporal workflows and activities. It offloads model requests and tool calls to Temporal activities.

nodes.label: Default Logfire Setup
nodes.title: Default Logfire Setup
nodes.description: A utility function that configures and returns a Logfire instance, instrumenting Pydantic AI for observability within Temporal workflows.

nodes.label: Temporal Logfire Plugin
nodes.title: Temporal Logfire Plugin
nodes.description: A Temporal client plugin that integrates Logfire for observability, setting up tracing interceptors and configuring metrics reporting to Logfire.

nodes.label: Temporal MCP Toolset Base
nodes.title: Temporal MCP Toolset Base
nodes.description: Abstract base class for Temporal-wrapped MCP toolsets, integrating 'get_tools', 'get_instructions', and 'call_tool' methods as Temporal activities for durable execution.

nodes.label: Temporal Run Context
nodes.title: Temporal Run Context
nodes.description: A specialized 'RunContext' subclass designed for Temporal workflows, providing serialization and deserialization logic for agent execution context within Temporal activities.

nodes.label: Temporal Toolset Wrapper
nodes.title: Temporal Toolset Wrapper
nodes.description: Function to wrap Pydantic AI toolsets (like 'FunctionToolset', 'DynamicToolset', 'MCPServer') with Temporal activities, enabling durable execution of tool operations.

nodes.label: Temporal Wrapper Toolset
nodes.title: Temporal Wrapper Toolset
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all Temporal-wrapped toolsets, providing common logic for managing lifecycle and handling tool call results within Temporal activities.
